Harissa Chickpea Stew

A written-for-this-repo stew for testing two-column prints.

Yield: 4 servings

Ingredients

  • 2 tablespoons olive oil
  • 1 large onion, chopped
  • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 tablespoon harissa
  • 2 cans chickpeas, drained
  • 1 can crushed tomatoes
  • 2 cups vegetable stock
  • 4 cups baby spinach
  • Salt and pepper

Directions

Warm the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and cook the onion until it is soft and golden, about eight minutes.

Stir in the garlic and harissa and cook for one minute, until fragrant.

Add the chickpeas, tomatoes and stock, bring to a simmer and cook for twenty minutes, until thickened.

Fold in the spinach until it wilts, then season with salt and pepper and serve.
